items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: But there's been a lot of the artists around here, like Lee Bates. They've been going in and out. Many times I don't know.

ctx.x: But, okay, well, I guess it hasn't been. Errol King's in here pretty often, isn't he? Right. He's working on an album with George Porter, if I'm not mistaken. Yes. We play Bigfoot. George Lottis played Bigfoot on a show we had in the meters. That sounds really great. Something that we'll probably be listening to in 20 years from now. Who are some of the other artists that are in the studio, or have been in the studio recently?

Wayne Cochran. Wayne Cochran. I haven't taken anyone in myself in months, deliberately. But there's been a lot of the artists around here, like Lee Bates. They've been going in and out. Many times I don't know.
Are you, or are you personally involved in right now? Are you working on an album yourself?
